observed_primary_source_facts: SoulX-Duplug is described upstream as a plug-and-play streaming semantic VAD/state-prediction module for realtime full-duplex speech conversation.
The model is 0.6B-class and exposes streaming dialogue states idle, nonidle, speak and blank, with ASR segment/buffer text attached to semantic state decisions.
The reference configuration explicitly documents Chinese via Paraformer, English via SenseVoice language=en, and bilingual via SenseVoice language=auto.
The official Hugging Face model metadata lists languages en and zh; the official evaluation dataset metadata also lists en and zh.
The upstream repository released re-implemented training/fine-tuning code on 2026-07-17, so language/domain adaptation is an executable research direction rather than a purely hypothetical one.

The reference server uses an accumulated ASR buffer covering the past 3.2 seconds for streaming state decisions; this is an architectural latency/context tradeoff that must be measured on Frankenstein German overlap/backchannel traffic.

source_scope_falsifier.question: Does current upstream evidence establish German support strongly enough for direct Frankenstein German production-turn-control consideration?
source_scope_falsifier.reason: The audited official source, model metadata and evaluation set establish English/Chinese/bilingual paths but do not establish German training, evaluation or production behavior.
source_scope_falsifier.what_is_not_falsified: German adaptation or fine-tuning using the released training code, and reuse of the streaming semantic-state architecture as a donor.

useful_donor_features: streaming state events suitable for a deterministic cancellation/commit FSM
ASR-aware state evidence that can feed VoiceIntent/GWT without becoming canonical authority
frankenstein_mapping.authority_boundary: SoulX-Duplug output remains candidate measurement only; it cannot mint VoiceOutcome, canonical memory/state, tool effects or completion authority.

hypothesis: A German-adapted SoulX-Duplug-style semantic streaming controller may reduce false interruptions and premature endpointing versus silence-only control while preserving fast backchannels and explicit WAIT behavior.
counterhypothesis: Its ASR-language dependence, 0.6B compute cost and multi-second rolling text context may erase the turn-quality benefit on the actual Frankenstein German latency/resource Pareto frontier; a lighter dedicated endpoint predictor may win.
cheapest_next_discriminator: After a terminal clay-direct-dev hardware/resource receipt exists, run the common pinned German pause/backchannel/overlap replay across the existing turn-controller candidates. Include upstream SoulX-Duplug only if the resource envelope admits it; otherwise first benchmark a German fine-tuned/adapted derivative in quarantine as a distinct semantic objective.
